task.title: Use a Duo Bypass Code
task.shortdesc: How can you obtain and use temporary Duo bypass codes when you cannot access your registered authentication device.

context.p: Generating and using Duo bypass codes works the same way for all NC State students, faculty, and staff. Self-service bypass codes are not available; codes are issued only by the NC State Help Desk, are valid for one-time use only, and expire one hour after they are generated.

step.cmd: Contact the NC State Help Desk 24/7 by calling 919-515-4357 (HELP), or submit an IT Service Portal request or email help@ncsu.edu with your availability Monday through Friday from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. to schedule a Google Meet or Zoom verification meeting.
Sign in to the NC State login prompt with your Unity ID and password.
Select "Other options" or "Enter a Passcode" if Duo automatically sends a push notification (or enter the bypass code directly into the "Second password" field if logging into the VPN).
Select Bypass code, enter your bypass code in the "Bypass code" field, and select "Verify".
When prompted, select "Yes, this is my device" if you are on your own device, or select "No, other people use this device" if you are on a shared computer such as a library workstation.
